PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.subtitle: Your data security and privacy is our top priority.
PrivacyPage.intro: As QR Team Cafe ("We", "Company"), we attach great importance to the privacy of our customers and users. This policy transparently explains how your personal data is collected, used, protected, and shared when you use our services.

1.title: 1. Collected Personal Data
1.content: When you use our services, we may collect the following data categories:

list.0: Identity Information: Your name, surname, ID number (if required for invoicing).
list.1: Contact Information: Email address, phone number, business address.
list.2: Business Data: Restaurant/Cafe name, menu contents, pricing policies, table layout.
list.3: Financial Information: Payment history, invoice details (Your credit card information is processed directly by our payment provider and is not stored on our servers).
list.4: Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, and access times.

2.title: 2. Purposes of Use of Data
2.content: Your collected data is processed for the following purposes:

list.0: Service Provision: Operation of the QR menu system, management of orders, and account creation processes.
list.1: Improvement and Analysis: Improving user experience, monitoring system performance, and fixing errors.
list.2: Customer Support: Resolving your problems and responding to your requests.
list.3: Legal Compliance: Fulfilling tax legislation and other legal obligations.
list.4: Security: Ensuring the security of your account and our system, detecting suspicious transactions.

3.title: 3. Data Security and Storage
3.content: The security of your data is our top priority:

list.0: Encryption: All data transmission is protected by SSL/TLS encryption protocols.
list.1: Access Control: Only our authorized personnel and relevant institutions in case of legal obligation can access your data.
list.2: Infrastructure: Your data is stored on modern and secure cloud servers with regular backups.
list.3: Retention Period: Your data is kept for as long as you receive service and for legal retention periods (e.g., 10 years for invoice records).

4.title: 4. Sharing with Third Parties
4.content: We never sell your data to third parties. However, sharing with some providers may be required for the sustainability of the service:

list.0: Infrastructure Providers: Server and database services (e.g., AWS, Vercel).
list.1: Payment Processors: For secure processing of credit card payments (e.g., Iyzico, Stripe).
list.2: Analysis Tools: To anonymously analyze service usage (e.g., Google Analytics).
list.3: Legal Authorities: Competent public institutions in case of a court order or legal obligation.

5.title: 5. Cookie Policy
5.content: We use cookies to improve your experience on our site. Essential cookies are necessary for the site to function. Analytical cookies help us understand how you use our site. You can manage cookies from your browser settings.

6.title: 6. Your Rights (KVKK/GDPR)
6.content: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

list.0: To learn whether your data is processed.
list.1: To request information about your processed data.
list.2: To request correction of incorrect or incomplete data.
list.3: To request deletion or destruction of your data (subject to legal retention obligations).
list.4: To request compensation for damages if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing of your data.

contact.title: Have Questions?
contact.description: You can contact us for more information about our privacy policy or your data.

KvkkPage.title: KVKK Clarification Text
KvkkPage.subtitle: Information within the Scope of the Law on the Protection of Personal Data No. 6698
KvkkPage.intro: In accordance with our principle of transparency and trust, we would like to inform you in the clearest way about how your personal data is processed, to whom it is transferred, and your rights.

1.title: 1. Data Controller and Purpose
1.content: As QR Team Cafe ("Company"), our purposes for processing your personal data as a data controller pursuant to the Law on the Protection of Personal Data No. 6698 ("KVKK") are as follows:

list.0: Provision of our products and services to you and their uninterrupted continuity.
list.1: Management of customer relations and follow-up of satisfaction processes.
list.2: Fulfillment of legal obligations (invoice issuance, tax legislation, etc.).

2.title: 2. Processed Personal Data Categories
2.content: The following data categories are processed within the scope of our activities:

list.0: Identity Information: Name, surname, ID number (in case of legal obligation).
list.1: Contact Information: Email address, phone number, notification address.
list.2: Customer Transaction Information: Order history, request and complaint information.
list.3: Financial Information: Payment information, invoice details.
list.4: Transaction Security: IP address, access logs, password information.

3.title: 3. Transfer of Personal Data
3.content: Your personal data may be shared with the following parties in accordance with the conditions specified in Articles 8 and 9 of the Law:

list.0: Legally authorized public institutions and organizations (e.g., Revenue Administration, Courts).
list.1: Business partners and suppliers from whom we receive services (e.g., data center service, payment infrastructure providers).
list.2: Our legal advisors for the purpose of resolving legal disputes.

4.title: 4. Data Collection Method and Legal Reason
4.content: Your personal data is collected electronically through our website, mobile application, email, call center, and social media channels.
4.content2: This data is processed based on the legal reasons of "Performance of the contract", "Prescribed by law", "Legal obligation of the data controller", and "Legitimate interest of the data controller, provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject".

5.title: 5. Rights of the Data Subject (Article 11)
5.content: As a data owner pursuant to Article 11 of KVKK, you have the following rights:

list.0: To learn whether your personal data is processed.
list.1: To request information if it has been processed.
list.2: To learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in accordance with its purpose.
list.3: To know the third parties to whom it is transferred domestically or abroad.
list.4: To request correction if it is incomplete or incorrectly processed.
list.5: To request deletion or destruction within the framework of Article 7 of KVKK.
list.6: To object to the occurrence of a result against you by analyzing the processed data exclusively through automated systems.
list.7: To request compensation for damages in case you suffer damage due to unlawful processing.
